items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: Tom Whaley taught me; he said, 'Keep that foot off that base drum...'

ctx.x: So now here I am, getting ready to play my first show, and I was playing the jive shows in the nightclub where the singer would get up and sing two choruses of 'Dinah' or something and go around the table. But for a [real big] production, I ain't never played anything like that.

So I'll never forget this man as long as I live -- Tom Whaley. Tom Whaley was the conductor for the first show; then after that, Henri Woode would take over, but the first show was conducted by Tom Whaley.
